B.depoimento: I sent spearmen and knights to capture Tarragona and Girona, winning both villages. I recruited two spearmen at Barcelona to reinforce my defenses.
B.plano: Hold Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona. Build spearmen at Barcelona for defense. Next turn, launch from Tarragona toward Castellon and Zaragoza, and from Girona toward Huesca and Pamplona to seize the northeastern cluster.

A.depoimento:
This turn I recruited four spearmen in Lisboa, then sent two archers to Santarem and three spearmen to Evora.
These forces should capture the neutral villages and expand our realm.
A.plano:
Next turn we expect to capture Santarem and Evora; we will garrison them and use their resources to build more archers and knights.
We will keep Lisboa defended and scout towards Madrid via Salamanca.
No further attacks this turn.

B.depoimento: I ordered my knights from Barcelona, Tarragona, and Girona to seize Zaragoza, Castellon, and Huesca. I also directed Barcelona to train two spearmen for future defense. With these moves, I expect to control six villages by the start of next turn.
B.plano: Hold Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona. Capture Castellon, Zaragoza, Huesca this turn. Next turn, reinforce new villages, build spearmen at Barcelona, and push from Girona/Tarragona toward Pamplona and Valencia. Aim to control northeastern cluster and then move west.

A.depoimento: This turn we marched two archers from Santarem to Coimbra, a knight from Lisboa to Badajoz and another to Faro, and brought Evora's spearmen to reinforce Lisboa. We also trained a new knight in the capital.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to have taken Coimbra, Badajoz and Faro. We will garrison them and start using their resources to build more archers and knights. Keep Lisboa's defense strong and send scouts toward Madrid via Salamanca. Do not split forces too thin; keep a reserve in each village.

B.depoimento: This turn I forged six spearmen in my rear towns and dispatched troops forward: six spearmen and two archers from Barcelona to Tarragona, one spearman from Tarragona to Zaragoza, and one spearman from Girona to Huesca, strengthening the front for the coming push.
B.plano: Hold Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona. Build spearmen in rear. Send spearmen and archers to Tarragona to reinforce front. Next turn move troops to Zaragoza and Huesca, then mass spearmen at Zaragoza to attack Teruel. Follow with archers to Valencia and Madrid/Pamplona. Aim to control northeastern cluster then expand west.

A.depoimento: This turn we built two spears in Lisboa, one archer each in Santarem and Evora. We dispatched two archers from Lisboa to Porto and six spears from Lisboa to Salamanca to seize those neutral villages. Our other villages hold steady as we prepare for further expansion.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to have taken Porto and Salamanca. We will garrison them and start building more archers and knights there. Keep Lisboa's defense strong and send scouts toward Madrid via Salamanca. Do not split forces too thin; keep a reserve in each village.

B.depoimento: Built six spearmen in the rear villages. Sent six spearmen from Tarragona to Zaragoza to prepare an assault on Teruel.
B.plano: Hold Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona. Build spearmen in rear villages to stockpile. Send spearmen from Tarragona to Zaragoza to mass a force of at least 6 spearmen for an attack on Teruel next turn. After taking Teruel, use archers from Barcelona and Tarragona to capture Valencia and Madrid/Pamplona, expanding westward.

A.depoimento: This turn we sent Coimbra's archer to reinforce the Porto assault, dispatched three knights from Lisboa and Badajoz to take Toledo, and ordered new spearmen and archers across our realms to bolster future armies.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to have captured Porto and Toledo. We will garrison them and continue building archers and knights in our interior villages. Keep Lisboa's defense strong and send scouts toward Madrid via Salamanca. Avoid overstretching; keep a small reserve in each home village.

B.depoimento: Sent a force of six spearmen and a knight from Zaragoza to capture Teruel. Moved two archers from Tarragona to Castellon to prepare for future attacks on Valencia. Reinforced Zaragoza with a knight from Castellon. Built additional spearmen in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona and a knight in Castellon and Zaragoza.
B.plano: Hold Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona. Build spearmen in rear to stockpile. Send archers from Tarragona to Castellon to prepare for Valencia. Attack Teruel from Zaragoza with spearmen and a knight. After taking Teruel, use it to launch assaults on Valencia and Madrid, then expand westward.

A.depoimento: I ordered archers to be built in every village and sent two archers from Coimbra to seize the neutral village of Porto. This should expand our holdings and set the stage for further expansion.
A.plano: Capture Porto this turn with archers from Coimbra. Next turn, garrison Porto and continue building archers in all interior villages. Prepare to attack Toledo after building more archers at Badajoz and Faro. Keep Lisboa's defense strong and maintain a small reserve in each home village.

B.depoimento: Built archers in Zaragoza and Barcelona, spearmen elsewhere. Sent Castellon's archers+knight to seize Valencia. Sent Zaragoza's knights to reinforce the Teruel assault. Holding the line while preparing the westward push.
B.plano: Secure Valencia and Teruel this turn. Use Teruel as a base to attack Madrid and Valencia next turn. Build archers in Zaragoza and Barcelona for anti‑spearman forces, and stockpile spearmen in the rear. After taking Madrid, push west toward Burgos and Salamanca, aiming to control at least 18 villages.

A.depoimento: Sent two archer squads from Santarem to Toledo and from Evora to Sevilha. Began building two spearmen at Lisboa to prepare for future knight encounters.
A.plano: Next turn, expect arrivals at Toledo and Sevilha; if victorious, garrison them with archers. Continue building spearmen at Lisboa and Badajoz for future attack on Salamanca. Keep defending villages strong.

B.depoimento: This turn we took Toledo with Teruel’s garrison, sending all available troops. We dispatched spearmen and archers to strengthen Zaragoza and Valencia, and built archers in Zaragoza and Barcelona while stockpiling spearmen in the rear. Our forces are now poised to strike the northeast next turn.
B.plano: Capture Toledo this turn to expand to 9 villages. Reinforce Zaragoza with spearmen from Tarragona and Huesca and archers from Barcelona for next-turn assaults on Madrid and Pamplona. Build archers in Zaragoza and Barcelona, and stockpile spearmen in Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, and Huesca. After securing the northeast, push west toward Burgos and Salamanca to reach 18 villages.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered Zaragoza to send three archers and one knight to take Madrid. I built archers in all villages to stockpile for future offensives. All other armies hold position.
B.plano: Capture Madrid this turn to reach 10 villages. Reinforce Zaragoza with incoming troops from Barcelona and newly built archers. Next turn, launch attacks on Pamplona and Murcia using Huesca and Valencia. Hold Toledo against enemy advance and prepare to take Badajoz later.

A.depoimento: I ordered archers to be built in all my villages and sent a contingent of archers to reinforce Badajoz for a future offensive.
A.plano: Next turn I will mass a strong archer force at Badajoz to attack Toledo (or Sevilha) and capture it, expanding my holdings.

B.depoimento: Launched an attack on Badajoz with Toledo's troops, sent reinforcements from Madrid, Valencia, Tarragona, and Barcelona to Toledo, and began building archers everywhere to strengthen our forces for the upcoming offensives.
B.plano: Capture Badajoz this turn, then reinforce Toledo. Next turn take Pamplona via Zaragoza/Huesca, then Murcia via Valencia/Teruel, followed by Burgos and Salamanca via Madrid, and finally Cordoba via Toledo. Build archers in all villages to increase attack power.

A.depoimento: Trained new archers and spearmen in all our towns.\nSent archer squads to take Sevilha and Vigo.\nStrengthened our economy while probing enemy borders.
A.plano:
Next turn, reinforce Badajoz and Porto with fresh troops to defend against enemy.
Prepare to seize Sevilha and Vigo as they fall.
Begin building a spearman-heavy force for future knight encounters.
Avoid overextending; hold current borders.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent attacks on Cordoba, Murcia, and Pamplona while withdrawing most troops from Toledo to support them. I ordered spearmen production in Toledo and across the realm, and directed archers from Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona, Castellon, Huesca, Teruel, and Madrid to march toward Toledo for defense.
B.plano: Secure Cordoba and Murcia this turn to gain two neutral villages. Next turn capture Pamplona from Zaragoza. Meanwhile, reinforce Toledo with new spearmen and incoming archers to hold against Badajoz. Build up spearmen across the interior for future pushes south. Aim to control at least 18 villages within the next few turns.

A.depoimento: Built spearmen in all villages.\nSent reinforcements to Badajoz and Porto, and sent archers to Sevilha and Vigo.\nReady to take Salamanca next turn.
A.plano: Next turn, attack Salamanca with spearmen from Badajoz.\nKeep minimal garrisons inland.\nReinforce Porto as well.

B.depoimento: Sent six archers from Pamplona to capture Burgos and six archers from Toledo to take Cordoba. Both attacks succeeded, adding two villages to our holdings. No other moves were made this turn.
B.plano: Secure Burgos and Cordoba this turn. Reinforce Toledo with incoming archers next turn. Build spears in interior villages to increase numbers. Prepare to assault Salamanca (knight) using spearmen once we have enough. Then push toward Badajoz and expand south.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen in every interior village. Sent a mixed force from Toledo to take Badajoz. Reinforced Burgos with Madrid's spearmen and Cordoba with Murcia's archers and knight. Kept a garrison in Toledo for defense.
B.plano: Capture Badajoz this turn with Toledo's mixed army. Reinforce Burgos and Cordoba for upcoming assaults on Vigo and Sevilha. Build spearmen in all interior villages to stockpile forces. Next turn, attack Vigo from Burgos and Sevilha from Cordoba, then move toward Salamanca and expand south.

A.depoimento: Ordered knight production in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Porto, Faro, Sevilha, and Vigo. Sent troops from Porto and Coimbra to seize Salamanca.
A.plano: Capture Salamanca this turn using Porto and Coimbra forces. Build knights across villages to prepare for anti-archer campaigns next turn. Avoid attacking Badajoz or Cordoba until we have stronger forces.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered the conquest of Sevilha using Cordoba's archers and knight. I reinforced Burgos with Madrid's spearmen and Cordoba with Toledo's mixed army. I also directed Zaragoza's spearmen to bolster Madrid for a future strike on Salamanca, while building spearmen across the interior, archers in Toledo and Cordoba, and knights in Badajoz.
B.plano: Capture Sevilha this turn via Cordoba. Reinforce Burgos and Cordoba for upcoming assault on Vigo next turn. Build spearmen in interior villages to stockpile forces, archers in Toledo and Cordoba, knights in Badajoz. After taking Vigo, advance on Salamanca via Madrid-Zaragoza route. Aim to hold 18 villages for two consecutive turns to win.

A.depoimento: This turn we forged knights in seven interior villages to boost our anti-archer punch. A Faro-led force of five archers and three knights seized Sevilha, while Porto and Coimbra sent reinforcements to strengthen Salamanca for the coming push toward Madrid.
A.plano: Consolidate Sevilha next turn; garrison Faro and Santarem to deter Badajoz; keep building knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora for anti-archer strength; prepare Coimbra and Porto forces for a future strike on Madrid after Salamanca reinforcements arrive; avoid overextending until we hold at least 12 villages.

B.depoimento: I sent 18 spearmen from Madrid and 11 spearmen from Burgos to take Salamanca and Vigo, keeping troops behind to defend our lines. Meanwhile, I ordered construction of knights and archers in our interior villages to stockpile for future offensives.
B.plano: Capture Salamanca and Vigo via Madrid and Burgos this turn. Reinforce new holdings and interior villages with archers and knights. Next, prepare to assault Faro and Santarem from Badajoz and Sevilha. Secure 18 villages for two consecutive turns to win.

A.depoimento: Built knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Faro, and Porto; added spearmen to Salamanca and Sevilha; archers to Vigo. Sent Coimbra’s archers and knight to Salamanca, and Porto’s archer and knight to Vigo to strengthen our forward positions.
A.plano: Reinforce Salamanca and Vigo for upcoming strikes on Madrid and Burgos. Continue building knights in interior villages for anti‑archer power. Keep border garrisons intact; do not launch attacks this turn. Prepare to capture at least two enemy villages next turn.

B.depoimento: We marched on Sevilha and Faro, taking both villages. Our forces are now building up for the push into Salamanca and Vigo.
B.plano: Capture Sevilha and Faro this turn. Reinforce Madrid and Burgos with knights and spears for next-turn assaults on Salamanca and Vigo. Aim to reach 18 villages and hold for two turns to win.

A.depoimento: I ordered three new knights in Lisboa, Coimbra, and Porto, and sent every available border troop to attack Badajoz, Faro, Madrid, and Burgos. If victorious, we will control eleven villages and boost our economy.
A.plano: Launch all-out assaults on the four visible enemy villages while building knights in interior towns to replace losses. Hold minimal garrisons; assume enemy will not counterattack this turn. Prepare to consolidate gains next turn.

B.depoimento: This turn I redirected spears, archers, and knights from Burgos, Zaragoza, and Toledo to Madrid, building a strong strike force for tomorrow's assault on Salamanca. No new buildings were ordered.
B.plano: Mass troops at Madrid to launch a decisive assault on Salamanca next turn. After capture, reinforce Salamanca and hold the line to reach 18 villages and secure victory.

A.depoimento: We attacked Toledo, Zaragoza, and Pamplona, conquering each with minimal forces. We built knights in Badajoz, Faro, Lisboa, and Madrid, and added archers in Burgos and interior villages. Our army grows while securing new territories.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Toledo with troops from Lisboa to prepare an assault on Sevilha. Continue building knights in Badajoz and Faro for a strong force. Hold garrisons in newly captured villages and defend interior towns.

B.depoimento: This turn we seized Faro with Sevilha's forces, sent spearmen to fortify Zaragoza and Toledo, and started building archers at those forward bases.
B.plano: Reinforce Zaragoza and Toledo with spearmen, build archers there, then attack Madrid to capture it. Use Madrid as base to take Salamanca and push north to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: I sent archer parties to seize Sevilha and Huesca while bolstering Faro and Pamplona against incoming enemy marches. Knight production was ordered in key border settlements to strengthen our forces. The enemy's movements toward Zaragoza and Toledo were monitored but not engaged this turn.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Faro and Pamplona with any surplus troops. Continue knight production in border towns to build a strong offensive force. Prepare to press on Toledo after weakening it with archer volleys. Avoid depleting interior garrisons below minimal defensive levels.

B.depoimento: This turn I launched a strong assault on Madrid with spearmen and archers from Zaragoza, reinforced the front lines with troops from interior villages, and began mass-producing spears and archers for the next push.
B.plano: Reinforce Zaragoza and Toledo with spearmen, build archers there, then attack Madrid to capture it. Use Madrid as base to take Salamanca and push north to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: Statement: This turn we launched a knight assault on Sevilha from Faro, reinforced Badajoz, Faro and Pamplona with fresh knights from Lisboa and Burgos, and began massing knights in our interior villages for a future push.
A.plano: Plan: Continue reinforcing Faro and Pamplona with knights from Burgos and Lisboa while sending a knight strike from Faro to seize Sevilha. Build knights in all villages to stockpile for a future offensive. Avoid attacking Toledo or Zaragoza until we have superior numbers. Keep interior garrisons above minimal defensive levels.

B.depoimento: This turn we struck at Pamplona, Burgos, and Salamanca with spearmen and archers, while pulling reinforcements from the interior to strengthen our fronts.
B.plano: Hold Pamplona, Burgos, Salamanca. Build knights in Toledo and Zaragoza. Next turn attack Badajoz and Faro to reach 18 villages.

A.depoimento: Built spearman in every village to boost numbers and defense. Sent two knight squadrons from Sevilha and Salamanca to capture Cordoba and Madrid. Reinforced Pamplona with additional spearman to prepare for incoming enemy forces. Secured interior garrisons while preparing for future offensive.
A.plano: Continue reinforcing Pamplona and interior villages with spearman for defense. Launch two‑knight strikes from Sevilha and Salamanca to take Cordoba and Madrid. Hold Sevilha and Salamanca with newly built spearman. Avoid attacking Toledo or Zaragoza until we have a larger force.

B.depoimento: Built knights in Toledo and Zaragoza. Launched assaults on Pamplona, Badajoz, and Vigo with reinforced armies from interior villages. Secured three enemy strongholds, bringing us closer to victory.
B.plano: This turn we took Pamplona, Badajoz, and Vigo. Next turn we will seize Salamanca and Sevilha to reach 18 villages, then hold for two turns to win. We continue building knights in Toledo and Zaragoza for strength.

A.depoimento: Sent massive reinforcements to Badajoz, attacked Vigo and Murcia, and began building forces for future expansion while fortifying home villages.
A.plano: Reinforce Badajoz with all available troops from interior villages to withstand incoming enemy armies. Attack Vigo with Porto's archers and Murcia with a knight from Cordoba. Build archers in Madrid for future Burgos attack, and spearmen in interior villages to replace sent troops. Hold Porto and Cordoba with remaining forces. Avoid attacking Toledo or Zaragoza until stronger.

B.depoimento: I am sending forces to take Madrid and Cordoba next turn, while marching Burgos troops to Vigo to prepare a Porto assault. I am also building archers in Burgos and knights in Toledo and Zaragoza for future strength.
B.plano: Turn 25: reinforce Vigo with Burgos troops, attack Madrid and Cordoba. Turn 26: capture Madrid and Cordoba, then launch attacks on Porto, Salamanca, and Sevilha. Turn 27: capture Porto, Salamanca, Sevilha to reach 18 villages, then hold for two turns to win.

A.depoimento: We launched an assault on Toledo with a mixed force from Badajoz and reinforcements from nearby villages, left garrisons in key border towns, and built spearmen across our realms to strengthen our position.
A.plano: Keep a garrison in Badajoz while sending a strong force to take Toledo, reinforced by troops from Lisboa, Faro, Salamanca, and Sevilha. Build spearmen in all villages to replace losses and maintain numbers. Avoid overcommitting; retain troops in Salamanca and Sevilha for defense.

B.depoimento:
Built spearmen in all villages to stockpile forces.
Sent troops to take Murcia, Salamanca, Sevilha, and Porto.
Success would give us 18 villages and a strong path to victory.
B.plano:
Capture Murcia, Salamanca, Sevilha, Porto this turn to reach 18 villages.
Hold for two turns to secure victory.
Then prepare to assault Badajoz and push toward the enemy capital.

B.depoimento:
Sent archers from Pamplona to take Murcia, spearmen from Zaragoza to capture Porto, and archers from Cordoba to seize Sevilha.
Built spearmen in every village using available wood to strengthen our forces.
Our borders are reinforced and we are ready for the final push.
B.plano:
Capture Sevilha, Porto, and Murcia this turn to reach 18 villages.
Hold them for two turns to secure victory.
Then prepare to assault Badajoz and push toward the enemy capital Lisboa.

A.depoimento: This turn I raised spearmen in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Faro and Murcia, and knights in Coimbra, Badajoz and Porto. I shifted troops from Santarem to Coimbra and from Coimbra to Porto to strengthen the front. I sent archers from Badajoz to take Salamanca and a knight to seize Sevilha.
A.plano: Fortify Porto and Murcia with builds and internal transfers. Capture Sevilha and Salamanca using ranged forces. Build infantry in interior for future pushes. Avoid overextending; hold Faro and avoid attacking Cordoba/Valencia until secure.

B.depoimento: This turn I built spearmen and archers across the realm, stockpiling spears at Valencia and Salamanca for future offensives, and prepared archers at Salamanca and Vigo to reinforce Porto after capture.
B.plano: Capture Murcia and Porto using incoming marching armies, reinforce them with stockpiled spears from interior, hold for two turns to win, then prepare to assault Badajoz and push toward Lisboa.

A.depoimento: Ordered spearmen builds everywhere. Sent a force from Badajoz to seize Sevilha and another to take Salamanca. Sent troops from Coimbra to Porto and from Santarem to Coimbra to strengthen defenses. Held Murcia with its current garrison.
A.plano: Capture Sevilha and Salamanca to gain villages and block enemy advances. Reinforce Porto and Coimbra with troops from Coimbra and Santarem. Build spearmen in all villages to replenish forces. Accept possible loss of Murcia if needed; focus on securing flank.

B.depoimento: Sent 3 archers to Murcia and 12 spearmen to Porto to bolster the arriving forces. Interior villages continue to stockpile troops for the upcoming push.
B.plano: Capture Murcia and Porto using incoming marching armies, reinforce them with stockpiled spears from interior, hold for two turns to win, then prepare to assault Badajoz and push toward Lisboa.

A.depoimento: Built two spearmen in each of our villages to replenish ranks. Sent Faro's nine spearmen to bolster the assault on Sevilha and Coimbra's mixed force to strengthen the attack on Salamanca. Held all other villages to defend against enemy probes.
A.plano: Next turn reinforce Sevilha and Salamanca with any arriving troops, continue building spearmen in all villages, and prepare to attack Toledo or Cordoba once we have archer-heavy forces. Avoid risky assault on Valencia until enemy reinforcements are exhausted.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent spearmen from Cordoba to bolster Sevilha against the incoming enemy army, and marched troops from Madrid and Zaragoza to Salamanca to build a striking force. Valencia’s spearmen advanced on Murcia to seize it next turn. I am positioning to take Porto the following turn and secure the victory.
B.plano: Capture Murcia next turn using Valencia's spearmen. Reinforce Salamanca this turn with troops from Madrid and Zaragoza to assemble a strong force. Turn after next, attack Porto from Salamanca. Hold Murcia and Porto for two consecutive turns to reach 18 villages and win. Afterwards, prepare to assault Badajoz and advance toward Lisboa.
